====================================================================================================
                     CobbleEffort @VERSION@: extra cosmetic forms for Cobblemon                     
====================================================================================================

CobbleEffort adds 41 collections of cosmetic forms (1488 Pokemon) to Cobblemon, plus 61 new Pokemon.
Each form is a new look for an existing Cobblemon model. Every cosmetic covers whole evolutionary
lines: if one stage has it, its pre-evolutions and evolutions have it too, and the look stays
through evolution, gender, regional forms, megas and shinies (shinies get their own version).

INSTALL
-------
1. Unzip this file and put the .jar in your mods folder. It works on Fabric and NeoForge (Minecraft
   1.21.1, Cobblemon 1.7.0 or newer, built for 1.8.4).
2. Remove any older cobbleeffort-*.jar first: two copies of the same mod stop the game from
   starting.
3. It must be installed on the server too (and in single player it just works).

HOW TO GET A COSMETIC
---------------------
In survival: give a supported Pokemon the collection's item as its COSMETIC ITEM, the same way as
any Cobblemon cosmetic (hold the item, open the Pokemon's interaction menu and put it in the
cosmetic slot). Take the item back to remove the look. A Pokemon can wear one cosmetic at a time.

In creative: every collection's cosmetic items (and the Paradox mega stones) are in the CobbleEffort
tab of the creative inventory. The mega stones only show there when Mega Showdown is installed.

With commands (creative / operators): /pokegive <pokemon> <form>, for example /pokegive snorlax
christmas or /pokegive snorlax christmas shiny. The <form> word for each collection is listed below.

====================================================================================================
#1  BACKROOMS (STILL LIFES)  (41 Pokemon)
====================================================================================================
Pokemon re-imagined as Still Lifes from Kane Pixels' Backrooms: imperfect copies the Backrooms
rebuilt from memory.

Cosmetic item: Yellow Carpet
Command:       /pokegive magnemite backrooms   (add 'shiny' for the shiny version)

The look:
  * colour drained into a sallow plaster / wet-clay palette under Level 0's yellow fluorescent light
  * damp blotches, clay grain and wobbly seams; rows of the texture slipped sideways like a bad copy
  * matte painted-on eyes with a second misplaced pair just below and a smear running down
  * no glow: glowing parts are switched off
  * shiny: its own Still Life, with a faint trace of the shiny colour showing through

Pokemon (each line is a whole evolutionary family):
  - Magnemite > Magneton > Magnezone
  - Omanyte > Omastar
  - Nincada > Ninjask / Shedinja
  - Torkoal
  - Anorith > Armaldo
  - Snorunt > Glalie / Froslass
  - Piplup > Prinplup > Empoleon
  - Blitzle > Zebstrika
  - Shelmet > Accelgor
  - Fletchling > Fletchinder > Talonflame
  - Swirlix > Slurpuff
  - Amaura > Aurorus
  - Xerfawn (Baby Legends) > Xerneas
  - Silicobra > Sandaconda
  - Sizzlipede > Centiskorch
  - Impidimp > Morgrem > Grimmsnarl
  - Nymble > Lokix
  - Maschiff > Mabosstiff

#2  THANKSGIVING (HARVEST)  (37 Pokemon)
====================================================================================================
Pokemon dressed for a Thanksgiving table.

Cosmetic item: Pumpkin Pie
Command:       /pokegive miltank thanksgiving   (add 'shiny' for the shiny version)

The look:
  * colours moved onto a harvest palette: cranberry, peach, pumpkin, maize gold, sage, chestnut,
    plum
  * greys, whites and blacks become pie-crust cream, cinnamon and dark roast
  * a golden-brown roast glaze along the edges and a few fallen maple leaves
  * eyes keep their original colours; glowing parts glow like candlelight
  * shiny: golden harvest, everything pulled toward honey-gold

Pokemon (each line is a whole evolutionary family):
  - Squirtle > Wartortle > Blastoise
  - Meowth > Persian / Perrserker
  - Porygon > Porygon2 > Porygon-Z
  - Corsola > Cursola
  - Miltank
  - Kecleon
  - Bagon > Shelgon > Salamence
  - Croagunk > Toxicroak
  - Carnivine
  - Munna > Musharna

  - Grubbin > Charjabug > Vikavolt

  - Pyukumuku

#3  HALLOWEEN (NIGHTMARE)  (33 Pokemon)
====================================================================================================
CONTENT WARNING: blood, gore, rotting flesh, wounds and body horror. If you don't want it, just
never use the Carved Pumpkin cosmetic.

Pokemon turned into nightmares, with animated textures (4 frames).

Cosmetic item: Carved Pumpkin
Command:       /pokegive charmander halloween   (add 'shiny' for the shiny version)

The look:
  * darkened, bruise-purple and rot-green skin with grime, lumps, torn raw patches and crude
    stitches
  * blood splatters with creeping drips
  * lots of extra, misplaced, bloodshot eyes (darting, blinking, weeping blood)
  * mouths full of jagged bloody teeth that gnash open and shut
  * shiny: a pale corpse, so the blood stands out more; glowing parts turn ghost-green

Special costumes:
  * Charmander > Charmeleon > Charizard
      Bone-Rot: skeletons with flesh rotting off the bones, an exposed rib cage, hollow eye sockets
      with a pink ember, and the tail fire burning pink
      Shiny: charred black bones

Pokemon (each line is a whole evolutionary family):
  - Charmander > Charmeleon > Charizard
  - Koffing > Weezing
  - Sentret > Furret
  - Misdreavus > Mismagius
  - Absol
  - Shinx > Luxio > Luxray
  - Glameow > Purugly
  - Timburr > Gurdurr > Conkeldurr
  - Sigilyph
  - Ducklett > Swanna
  - Pancham > Pangoro
  - Comfey
  - Komala
  - Dracovish
  - Tarountula > Spidops
  - Nacli > Naclstack > Garganacl
  - Klawf
  - Veluza

====================================================================================================
Christmas costumes for four lines and a Festive look for the rest.

Cosmetic item: Snowball
Command:       /pokegive snorlax christmas   (add 'shiny' for the shiny version)

The look:
  * Festive: a Christmas palette (crimson, gold, pine, icy blue, berry), snow settled on top,
    snowflakes
  * strings of fairy lights that glow in the dark and twinkle
  * shiny: Frosted, in silver, ice and snow

Special costumes:
  * Munchlax > Snorlax
      Santa Claus: red suit with white fur trim, black belt with a gold buckle, white beard
      Shiny: an old-world Father Christmas in green
  * Turtwig > Grotle > Torterra
      Christmas tree: pine needles, baubles, gold tinsel, twinkling fairy lights and snow
      Shiny: a white flocked tree
  * Trubbish > Garbodor
      Christmas gift: candy-stripe wrapping paper, a green satin ribbon, a bow and a gift tag
      Shiny: gold foil with a red ribbon
  * Phantump > Trevenant
      Krampus: shaggy black goat fur, ram's horns, red eyes that glow in the dark, iron chains with
      gold bells
      Shiny: white fur and gold horns

Pokemon (each line is a whole evolutionary family):
  - Munchlax > Snorlax
  - Turtwig > Grotle > Torterra

#7  ICE SCULPTURES  (42 Pokemon)
====================================================================================================
Pokemon carved out of a block of ice.

Cosmetic item: Ice, Packed Ice or Blue Ice
Command:       /pokegive axew ice_sculpture   (add 'shiny' for the shiny version)

The look:
  * clear glacier-ice blues mapped from the Pokemon's own light and shade, so every marking is
    chiselled in
  * faceted chisel planes, refracting light streaks, hairline cracks, trapped air bubbles and a
    frosted rim
  * glints that twinkle and glow in the dark; glowing parts turn to an icy cyan glow
  * shiny: Aurora Ice, shimmering teal to violet

Pokemon (each line is a whole evolutionary family):
  - Zubat > Golbat > Crobat
  - Oddish > Gloom > Vileplume / Bellossom
  - Drowzee > Hypno
  - Lickitung > Lickilicky

  * granite-grey stone with the markings kept as carved relief
  * stone grain, speckles, chisel strokes, chipped edges, cracks and the odd patch of moss and
    lichen
  * blank carved eyes; no glow (flames become carved stone)

====================================================================================================
Pokemon as the cards of the Major Arcana, one card per line.

Cosmetic item: Paper
Command:       /pokegive mrmime tarot   (add 'shiny' for the shiny version)

The look:
  * each line is one card, in that card's colours with a faint pattern: Mr. Mime = 0 The Fool;
    Carbink = II The High Priestess; Jangmo-o = IV The Emperor; Applin = VI The Lovers; Walking Wake
    = VII The Chariot; Cubchoo = VIII Strength; Pincurchin = IX The Hermit; Delibird = X Wheel of
    Fortune; Zangoose = XI Justice; Carvanha = XIII Death; Swablu = XIV Temperance; Salandit = XV
    The Devil; Chimchar = XVI The Tower; Marill = XVII The Star; Kabuto = XVIII The Moon; Lotad =
    XIX The Sun; Spearow = XX Judgement; Cosmog = XXI The World
  * a gilded card border round every part, the card's symbol on the chest (rose, crescent, ankh,
    heart, winged disc, infinity, lantern, wheel, scales, banner, triangle, pentagram, struck tower,
    stars, moon, sun, cross banner, wreath) and its Roman numeral on the forehead
  * glowing eyes and a gold-foil sheen that sweeps over the gilding (Star and World twinkle)
  * shiny: the card REVERSED: colours turned round, silver foil, symbol and numeral upside down

Pokemon (each line is a whole evolutionary family):
  - Mime Jr. > Mr. Mime > Mr. Rime
  - Carbink
  - Jangmo-o > Hakamo-o > Kommo-o
  - Applin > Flapple / Appletun / Dipplin > Hydrapple

#12  GAME BOY SPRITES (2D)  (33 Pokemon)
====================================================================================================
Pokemon as flat Game Boy sprites, in layers of 2D artwork.

Cosmetic item: Lime Dye
Command:       /pokegive krabby gb_sprite   (add 'shiny' for the shiny version)

The look:
  * the whole Pokemon becomes a flat pixel-art sprite in the Game Boy's four greens: drawn from its
    own model in its idle pose, one pixel per model unit, dark outlines and a little dithering
  * the sprite is made of a few flat layers stacked a little apart (front parts in front, back parts
    behind): head-on it's a sprite, from an angle the layers pop out like a paper cut-out; from
    behind you see its back sprite
  * an 8-bit bob when standing, a hop on every step, a jump for its cry
  * shiny: a Game Boy Color sprite in a four-colour palette taken from the shiny's own colours

Pokemon (each line is a whole evolutionary family):
  - Doduo > Dodrio
  - Krabby > Kingler
  - Tyrogue > Hitmonlee / Hitmonchan / Hitmontop
  - Aipom > Ambipom
  - Snubbull > Granbull
  - Minun
  - Tropius
  - Chingling > Chimecho
  - Relicanth
  - Pansear > Simisear
  - Bunnelby > Diggersby
  - Honedge > Doublade > Aegislash
  - Volcanion
  - Yungoos > Gumshoos
  - Minior
  - Shroodle > Grafaiai

Pokemon as celestial bodies: nebulae, galaxies, suns, moons, comets, black holes, ringed planets,

  * each line is one celestial body: nebula (Bulbasaur, Frillish), galaxy (Ekans, Spoink), sun
    (Victini, Archen), moon (Karrablast, Fomantis), comet (Electrike, Buizel), black hole (Stunky,
    Genesect), ringed planet (Spritzee, Bruxish), aurora (Feebas, Pansage), eclipse (Pawniard,
    Falinks)
  * stars scattered over the dark parts that twinkle in the dark; coronas, accretion rings, comet
    tails, auroras and planet rings glow
  * glowing eyes
  * shiny: the colours turned round the colour wheel (a blue sun, a green nebula...); the moon turns
    into a blood moon

Pokemon (each line is a whole evolutionary family):
  - Bulbasaur > Ivysaur > Venusaur

====================================================================================================
Pokemon as glowing creatures of the deep: anglerfish, jellyfish, lanternfish, comb jellies, firefly

====================================================================================================
NEW POKEMON
====================================================================================================
CobbleEffort's own Pokemon, each with a model, animations, a shiny and a way to get them. They are
on the CobbleEffort page of the Pokedex; in commands use the namespaced id, e.g. /pokegive
cobbleeffort:cavitot.

#0010 CATERPIE (COBBLEEFFORT FORM)  (Bug / Poison; Poison Point / Run Away (hidden))
  purple with a pink forked feeler, a cream belly and a curled yellow tail tip
  Stats: HP 45  Atk 30  Def 35  SpA 20  SpD 20  Spe 45  (total 195)
  Pokedex: "Its purple body warns every bird Pokémon away: it is laced with poison from the toxic
  leaves it eats. When something comes too close it rears up and flicks out its pink, forked feeler,
  which oozes a stinging, foul-smelling liquid."
  * Wild: common in jungles, swamps, flower forests and dark forests.
  * Evolves into the CobbleEffort Metapod at level 7.

#0011 METAPOD (COBBLEEFFORT FORM)  (Bug / Poison; Poison Point / Shed Skin (hidden))
  a purple shell studded with bright yellow warning spots
  Stats: HP 50  Atk 20  Def 55  SpA 25  SpD 25  Spe 30  (total 205)
  Pokedex: "Its shell is studded with bright yellow spots that shout poison to anything that would
  eat it. Inside, the toxins it gathered as a Caterpie are being brewed into wing scales."
  * Wild: uncommon in jungles, swamps and flower forests.
  * Evolves into the CobbleEffort Butterfree at level 10.

#0012 BUTTERFREE (COBBLEEFFORT FORM)  (Bug / Poison; Poison Touch / Tinted Lens (hidden))
  violet wings with dark veins and yellow warning spots, a plum body and yellow eyes
  Stats: HP 60  Atk 45  Def 50  SpA 90  SpD 80  Spe 70  (total 395)
  Pokedex: "Its wings shine violet and gold so no predator forgets them: one taste of their scales
  leaves a bird Pokémon numb for days. Flocks of them drift over jungle canopies, and the trees they
  rest in turn faintly purple."
  * Wild: rare in jungles and flower forests.

#0749 MUDBRAY (COBBLEEFFORT FORM)  (Dark; Moody / Stamina / Inner Focus (hidden))
  near-black with white skeleton markings, a white skull face, a black side-swept fringe with a
  purple streak and a black tail with red X marks
  Stats: HP 70  Atk 100  Def 70  SpA 45  SpD 55  Spe 45  (total 385)
  Pokedex: "It dyes its mane black, lets its fringe fall over its eyes and wears the pattern of a
  skeleton on its hide. It sulks in the shadows and kicks at anyone who calls it a phase."
  * Wild: uncommon in dark forests, badlands and spooky biomes.
  * Evolves into Ignitemare at level 30.

#3001 CAVITOT  (Dark; Strong Jaw / Stench / Stakeout (hidden))
  a single cream molar with a rotten black cavity in its top, pale pink diamond eyes, blush and a
  jagged frown, standing on two stubby roots
  Stats: HP 50  Atk 65  Def 60  SpA 30  SpD 45  Spe 50  (total 300)
  Pokedex: "It started out as a baby tooth that was never brushed. The cavity in its crown aches all
  the time, which is why it always looks so grumpy. It can't resist sweets, even though they make
  the ache worse."
  * Wild: common near sugar cane (sugar rots teeth) and in Dripstone Caves, uncommon underground and
    in villages at night.
  * Evolves into Amalgum at level 24.

#3002 AMALGUM  (Dark / Steel; Strong Jaw / Sturdy / Stakeout (hidden))
  three fused molars with sad faces, the two in front and a taller one behind, capped in dripping
  steel with grey amalgam fillings, on pink roots tipped with metal points
  Stats: HP 65  Atk 85  Def 95  SpA 40  SpD 60  Spe 55  (total 400)
  Pokedex: "Three Cavitot that had their cavities filled and fused into one. The metal in their
  fillings makes it tough to crack, but all three of its faces still frown. It gnaws on iron ore to
  keep its caps shiny."
  * Evolve Cavitot at level 24.
  * Wild: uncommon in Dripstone Caves, rare in the Deep Dark.

#3003 ORTHODREAD  (Dark / Steel; Strong Jaw / Iron Barbs / Stakeout (hidden))
  eight angry teeth set in a horseshoe like dentures on a pink plate, wearing steel caps, a braces
  wire and brackets with coloured elastics, spiked corner caps and four clawed steel legs
  Stats: HP 85  Atk 120  Def 120  SpA 50  SpD 80  Spe 70  (total 525)
  Pokedex: "Eight teeth held together by braces it can never take off. It scuttles through dark
  caves on its steel legs and its bite can crunch through iron. The braces put it in a foul mood,
  and it takes that out on anyone it meets."
  * Evolve Amalgum at level 42.
  * Wild: very rare in the Deep Dark and Dripstone Caves.

#3004 COALARVA  (Fire / Bug; Blaze / Skill Link (hidden))
  a grub of black coal with big ruby eyes, little feelers and curved pincers, and a fat segmented
  abdomen burning red-hot with a yellow-hot ring round each segment
  Stats: HP 45  Atk 55  Def 50  SpA 49  SpD 50  Spe 60  (total 309)
  Pokedex: "It lives in caves deep underground where coal seams run thick, and it eats nothing but
  coal. A special organ in its abdomen turns the minerals it swallows into heat, which is why its
  tail end always glows."
  * The CobbleEffort starter: pick it at the starter screen (its own CobbleEffort page, after
    Cobblemon's regions).
  * Wild: very rare underground next to coal ore.
  * Evolves into Cinderoon at level 16.

#3005 CINDEROON  (Fire / Bug; Blaze / Skill Link (hidden))
  a teardrop cocoon of see-through smouldering ash with glowing zigzag bands and embers, the
  Coalarva inside curled up with its ruby eyes peering out and its abdomen glowing through
  Stats: HP 60  Atk 45  Def 95  SpA 60  SpD 85  Spe 60  (total 405)
  Pokedex: "Once it has eaten enough coal, it wraps its soft body in a cocoon of cinders. The ash is
  thin enough to see the Coalarva curled up inside, and it can burn some of it away to hurl a blast
  of fire at anything that disturbs it."
  * Evolve Coalarva at level 16.

#3006 GATTERFLY  (Fire / Bug; Blaze / Skill Link (hidden))
  a huge butterfly of black coal with glowing cracks, ruby compound eyes, Gatling-gun arms whose
  barrel drums glow white-hot at the muzzle, and four wings made of fire
  Stats: HP 78  Atk 115  Def 80  SpA 104  SpD 75  Spe 82  (total 534)
  Pokedex: "Its arms have become guns that spray stingers so fast and so hot they glow, and its
  wings are made of fire. Besides fighting with them, it melts stone with its flames to build its
  nest."
  * Evolve Cinderoon at level 36. Learns its own move, Machine Gun Stinger, when it evolves.

#3007 PRAYLING  (Grass / Bug; Blindsight (its own: every move it uses hits) / Sniper (hidden))
  a tiny leaf-green baby mantis with no eyes, a wide triangular head, leafy feelers, little forelegs
  folded as if praying, four thin legs and a fan of leaves for a tail
  Stats: HP 45  Atk 60  Def 40  SpA 35  SpD 40  Spe 55  (total 275)
  Pokedex: "It is born without eyes, yet it never misses. It feels the faintest stir of air through
  its leafy feelers and knows exactly where its prey is, then holds its little forelegs together and
  waits."
  * Wild: common in jungles, uncommon in flower forests, meadows and forests.
  * Evolves into Mawntis at level 22.

#3008 MAWNTIS  (Grass / Bug; Blindsight (its own: every move it uses hits) / Sniper (hidden))
  a monstrous eyeless mantis with a large toothy maw, whip feelers, a spiky crest, big striped
  scythe claws with spines, six legs and a striped abdomen ending in leaves
  Stats: HP 65  Atk 95  Def 65  SpA 45  SpD 60  Spe 80  (total 410)
  Pokedex: "Its head has split into a maw full of fangs, and a second set of legs lets it run down
  prey in the undergrowth. It still has no eyes, but its scythes find their mark every time."
  * Evolve Prayling at level 22.
  * Wild: rare in jungles.

#3009 MANTASMA  (Grass / Ghost; Blindsight (its own: every move it uses hits) / Sniper (hidden))
  a gargantuan yet cute eyeless mantis: a huge round head that is mostly a grinning maw of fangs
  glowing violet inside, leafy horn-feelers, four scythe arms edged with glowing ghost blades and
  eight dark legs ringed with ghostly stripes
  Stats: HP 90  Atk 130  Def 90  SpA 70  SpD 85  Spe 75  (total 540)
  Pokedex: "A Mawntis that hunted on a moonless night and came back as something else. It towers
  over the trees, its grin glows in the dark, and its ghostly scythes cut through anything without
  ever missing. Even so, it still clasps its forelegs together the way it did as a Prayling."
  * Evolve Mawntis at level 40 or higher at night.
  * Wild: very rare in dark forests and jungles at night.

#3010 MUMPILLAR  (Water / Bug; Pharaoh's Curse (its own: once per battle, survives a knockout at half health with +2 Attack and Sp. Atk) / Torrent (hidden))
  a caterpillar swaddled in bandages like a little mummy, with a black visor face, two big round
  glowing yellow eyes, a bandage curl on its head and blue-patched bandaged segments on stubby black
  feet
  Stats: HP 50  Atk 52  Def 48  SpA 52  SpD 57  Spe 50  (total 309)
  Pokedex: "It wraps itself in strips of silk soaked in river water and never takes them off. Old
  tales say anyone who unwraps one is cursed, and that it cannot be finished off: struck down, it
  rises again angrier than before."
  * A CobbleEffort starter: pick it at the starter screen (the CobbleEffort page, with Coalarva).

  a mother opossum with huge dark ears, a black frilly collar and a pink-hearted belly, smiling,
  carrying six of her babies on her head, back and tail
  Stats: HP 105  Atk 70  Def 80  SpA 75  SpD 95  Spe 50  (total 475)
  Pokedex: "It carries a half dozen of its babies wherever it goes. When something threatens them it
  plucks the bravest ones off its back and slings them at the enemy with its tail; they come
  straight back to it, very pleased with themselves."
  * Evolve Obubby at level 30. It learns Joey Slingshot when it evolves.
  * Wild: uncommon in forests and plains at night.

#3053 AETHERIM  (Normal; Adaptability / Levitate (hidden))
  a tiny energy golem with a crest of three curved cream plates, big blue eyes, a glowing pearl on
  its forehead and two big floating stone fists
  Stats: HP 70  Atk 80  Def 80  SpA 80  SpD 80  Spe 80  (total 470)
  Pokedex: "A little golem of pure energy that shapes a body around a pearl. Give it a tuft of hair
  charged with a type's energy and it soaks it up, glowing that type's colour and becoming that
  type."
  * Wild: rare in hills, mountains and highlands.
  * Give it an elemental Tuft (or the matching wool, or a feather for Flying) in its cosmetic slot
    and it becomes that type.

#3054 INCL  (Water / Steel; Liquid Ooze / Sticky Hold / Clear Body (hidden))
  a small glossy blob of ink with glowing yellow eyes and a silver calligraphy pen nib for a face
  Stats: HP 40  Atk 45  Def 55  SpA 50  SpD 45  Spe 35  (total 270)
  Pokedex: "A drop of ink that came to life on the page of an old letter. The silver pen nib it
  wears as a face is sharp, and it scribbles angry lines on anything that bothers it."
  * Wild: rare at night in villages, and in deep-dark and dripstone caves.
  * Evolves into Incwell at level 30.

#3055 INCWELL  (Dark / Steel; Liquid Ooze / Sticky Hold / Clear Body (hidden))
  a column of glossy ink rising out of a glass inkwell, with a big silver pen nib for a head,
  glowing yellow eyes and two long dripping arms
  Stats: HP 60  Atk 75  Def 80  SpA 70  SpD 65  Spe 50  (total 400)
  Pokedex: "It lives in an inkwell it found in an abandoned study and never leaves it. At night it
  rises out of the well and writes threats on the walls with the tip of its nib."
  * Evolve Incl at level 30. It learns Dark Pulse when it evolves.
  * Evolves into Calligrimm at level 50.

#3056 CALLIGRIMM  (Dark / Steel; Liquid Ooze / Sticky Hold / Clear Body (hidden))
  a gargantuan ink kaiju crowned by a huge pen nib and horns of glowing ink-fire, with pen-nib claws
  and a gaping maw of broken glass shards in its chest
  Stats: HP 100  Atk 125  Def 110  SpA 90  SpD 85  Spe 50  (total 560)
  Pokedex: "A titan of living ink, tall as a castle tower. The shards of its shattered inkwell
  became its fangs, and old tales say whatever it writes with its claws comes true, so kingdoms once
  begged it never to write their names."
  * Evolve Incwell at level 50. It learns Crunch when it evolves.

#3057 IGNITEMARE  (Dark / Fire; Moody / Flame Body / Intimidate (hidden))
  a gaunt shadow horse with white ribs and spine showing, a bare horse skull with glowing red eyes
  and short black-tipped horns, fire snorting from its nostrils, bone-armoured legs split by glowing
  cracks and huge hooked claw-hooves
  Stats: HP 85  Atk 120  Def 80  SpA 85  SpD 75  Spe 80  (total 525)
  Pokedex: "When the CobbleEffort Mudbray's sulking turns to rage, its body burns away to a shadow
  round its bones. It gallops through badlands at night, snorting fire, and its hollow skull glows
  red with the grudges it refuses to let go."
  * Evolve the CobbleEffort Mudbray at level 30. It learns Flame Charge when it evolves.

====================================================================================================
PARADOX MEGA EVOLUTIONS (needs Mega Showdown)
====================================================================================================
22 Paradox Pokemon can Mega Evolve in battle, the same way as Mega Showdown's megas: hold the mega
stone, wear a Mega Bracelet, and press Mega Evolve in battle. Every stone is crafted from a Mega
Showdown Mega Stone, a Diamond and themed items, and is in the CobbleEffort creative tab.

      [ttt]
      [sms]
      [.d.]
      t = Bone Block, s = Mud Bricks, m = Mega Stone (Mega Showdown's), d = Diamond

====================================================================================================
WORKS WITH
====================================================================================================
CobbleEffort is built to run alongside Mega Showdown (+ Extra Megas, Ores), Cobblemon: AllTheMons x
Mega Showdown, Cobblemon Baby Legends, Cobblemon Lost Lore, Legendary Monuments, the Fully Hisuian
Starters resource pack and the Poke Costumes data pack. None of them is required.

  * Mega Showdown megas, Gigantamax and other forms of Pokemon in a collection get their own
    cosmetic look.
  * Baby Legends' Xerfawn and Latot belong to their legendary's line (Backrooms and Easter).
  * Forms from AllTheMons x Mega Showdown, Lost Lore, Fully Hisuian Starters and Poke Costumes keep
    their own look while the cosmetic is worn (their licences don't allow recoloured copies).
